Learn two <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrips</LSTag> of your choice. Additionally, Cantrips which cost an <LSTag Tooltip="Action">Action</LSTag> may be cast as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag> instead. This may be toggled at any time.

Gain a +8 bonus to Initiative and you cannot be Surprised. Upon starting combat, and upon starting your turn while Threatened, you immediately Dash and Disengage.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

Your summoned creatures gain an additional Action and Bonus Action.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

Gain the ability to charge toward nearby enemies as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag> once per turn, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_Charger_Attack">Attacking</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_Charger_Push">Shoving</LSTag> them in the process.
Charge into nearby enemies, making an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against the first you come in contact with.
Charge into nearby enemies, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Shove">Shoving</LSTag> the first you come in contact with.
Select two passives from the Zetherist passives list.
Select two passives from the Barbarian passives list.

Upon being damaged by an enemy, you may expend your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> in order to restore +1d6 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> multiplied by your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to yourself and all nearby allies. Additionally, when making a successful <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an enemy, you may expend your Reaction to heal allies near your target, including yourself.

Upon being damaged by an enemy, restore +1d6 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> multiplied by your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to yourself and all allies within [1] of you.

Upon making a successful <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an enemy, restore +1d6 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> multiplied by your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to all allies within [1] of them, including yourself.

When attacked, add your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> as a free <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag>. Then, you may use your Reaction to make an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against your aggressor. In addition, you gain an additional Reaction.
When attacked, add your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag>.
After avoiding an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, make one of your own against your aggressor.

While dual-wielding, gain the ability to make an off-hand attack as a Bonus Action, and Opportunity Attacks that you make will attack with both weapons.

In addition, you gain three Duellist Charges. These charges can be spent to gain Advantage on Attack Rolls, or to force enemies to attack you with Disadvantage. Once per turn, landing a killing blow or Critical Hit on an enemy will restore one charge.

Furthermore, you add your global Strength Modifier to weapon damage dealt while dual-wielding.

Gain Advantage on Attack Rolls, and force enemies to attack you with Disadvantage.

Once per turn, the first time you deal or take damage will consume one Duellist Charge. You may restore one Duellist Charge per turn by landing a killing blow or Critical Hit on an enemy.
Add your global <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Strength Modifier</LSTag> to weapon damage dealt while dual-wielding.

Spells you cast will not damage your allies when targeting an area. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus to your Difficulty Class. You may further increase this number by consuming Dunesis Charges. Upon casting a Spell, you generate one additional Dunesis Charge, up to a maximum of three.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

The amount of charges you may consume in order to increase your <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">Difficulty Class</LSTag>. Upon casting a Spell, you generate one additional Dunesis Charge, up to a maximum of three.
Consume <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="Dunesis">Dunesis Charges</LSTag> in order to increase your <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">Difficulty Class</LSTag>.
Consume one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="Dunesis">Dunesis Charge</LSTag> to gain a +1 bonus to your <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">Difficulty Class</LSTag>.
Affected creature has a +1 bonus to their <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">Difficulty Class</LSTag>.
Consume two <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="Dunesis">Dunesis Charges</LSTag> to gain a +2 bonus to your <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">Difficulty Class</LSTag>.
Affected creature has a +2 bonus to their <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">Difficulty Class</LSTag>.
Consume three <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="Dunesis">Dunesis Charges</LSTag> to gain a +3 bonus to your <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">Difficulty Class</LSTag>.
Affected creature has a +3 bonus to their <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">Difficulty Class</LSTag>.

Gain Resistance to physical damage and permanent Lockdown Immunity.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to two elemental damage types of your choice. When you deal damage of your chosen types to an enemy, you deal an additional +1d4 damage of that same type.

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Acid damage. In addition, when you deal Acid damage to an enemy, you deal an additional +1d4 damage.

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Cold damage. In addition, when you deal Cold damage to an enemy, you deal an additional +1d4 damage.

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Fire damage. In addition, when you deal Fire damage to an enemy, you deal an additional +1d4 damage.

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Force damage. In addition, when you deal Force damage to an enemy, you deal an additional +1d4 damage.

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Lightning damage. In addition, when you deal Lightning damage to an enemy, you deal an additional +1d4 damage.

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Necrotic damage. In addition, when you deal Necrotic damage to an enemy, you deal an additional +1d4 damage.

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Radiant damage. In addition, when you deal Radiant damage to an enemy, you deal an additional +1d4 damage.

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> to Thunder damage. In addition, when you deal Thunder damage to an enemy, you deal an additional +1d4 damage.

Once per turn, when you land a killing blow with a weapon-based Attack Roll, you can make another as a free action.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.
Affected creature may make another attack as a free action.
Make another attack as a free action.
Fire another attack as a free action.
Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to elemental damage and status based immunity to all conditions which damage you over time.

Any time that you roll a 7 or less on an Attack Roll, Saving Throw, Ability Check, or Skill Check, the result is immediately rerolled.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

Enemies you hit immediately lose <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag> on any Spells they were maintaining and become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SILENCED">Muted</LSTag> for one turn.

When making a Melee Weapon Attack, Unarmed Attack, or Ranged Weapon Attack, reduce the number needed to roll a Critical Hit by 2.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

You have a chance to experience a positive surge of Wild Magic at the beginning and end of combat encounters, at the beginning of each of your turns while in combat, and when dealing or taking damage while in combat.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

Melee based Attack Rolls you make with your main-hand add your Proficiency Bonus multiplied by two when rolling for damage. In addition, you ignore all physical Resistances and Immunities when dealing damage to an enemy or item.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

Gain <LSTag Tooltip="MusicalInstrumentProficiency">Musical Instrument Proficiency</LSTag>, as well as the ability to enter into a state of performative prescence in order to buff your party, granting them a +1d4 bonus on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>, and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
Through a unique performance, establish a state of prescence in order to buff your party.

Affected creature has a +1d4 bonus on all <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>, and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> due to a performative presence.

Add your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> to any <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> that you make. When healed, you always heal for the maximum amount possible.

Gain the ability to use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> to make a melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an enemy who enters your weapons range. Additionally, <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">Opportunity Attack</LSTag> you make will roll your <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.
Make a melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an enemy who enters your range.

Roll all of your damage dice with Advantage. Upon damaging an enemy, apply one stack of Shredded Armour.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

When an enemy makes an Attack Roll against an ally, you can use your Reaction in order to make a Attack Roll of your own against that enemy.

You gain Advantage on Opportunity Attacks, and when you hit a creature with a melee based Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn. In addition, you gain an additional Reaction.
When an enemy makes an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an ally, make a Attack Roll against that enemy.

Your <LSTag Tooltip="RangedWeaponAttack">Ranged Weapon Attacks</LSTag> and ranged Spells do not receive penalties from <LSTag Tooltip="HighGroundRules">High Ground Rules</LSTag>, and your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> is added twice when rolling for damage. In addition, you ignore all physical <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> when dealing damage to an enemy or item.

Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Dexterity based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> while wielding a shield. In addition, you gain a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="Shieldbearer">Shieldbearer Charge</LSTag> which can be used to negate an instance of incoming damage or reflect projectiles after performing a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShieldBlow_Riposte">Shield Bash</LSTag>. Once per turn, landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> on an enemy will restore your Shieldbearer Charge.

Allows you to utilize your Shield to negate an instance of incoming damage or reflect projectiles.

Once per turn, landing a killing blow or Critical Hit on an enemy will restore your Shieldbearer Charge.
Negate an instance of incoming damage.
After performing a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShieldBlow_Riposte">Shield Bash</LSTag>, reflect all incoming projectiles until the start of your next turn.
Affected creature will reflect all projectiles fired at them.

When casting a Spell or Cantrip, reduce the number needed to roll a Critical Hit by 2.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

When making an unarmed attack or Throw, your Strength Modifier is added to all damage rolls. Additionally, your Dexterity Modifier is added to all Attack Rolls.

Furthermore, melee weapons you equip in your Main-Hand gain the Thrown property. When thrown, they will return back to you.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

Cause your Main-Hand melee weapon to gain the <LSTag Tooltip="Thrown">Thrown</LSTag> property. When thrown, it will return to you. In addition, your weapon will gain the ability to fire a ranged projectile, which will carry the properties of the weapon.

Affected weapon has gained the <LSTag Tooltip="Thrown">Thrown</LSTag> property. When thrown, it will return to who threw it. In addition, the weapon has gained the ability to fire a ranged projectile.
Swing your Main-Hand melee weapon in order to create a projectile which carries the properties of your weapon. This action is considered to be the same as throwing your weapon.

Increase the amount of Hit Points you have by 4 per level. Additionally, you ignore all damage taken equal to 2 or less, and cannot be Critically Hit.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.

Gain Advantage on Concentration based Saving Throws. Additionally, you can cast Shocking Grasp against an enemy who enters into melee range as a free Reaction, as well as Bind your weapons.

Furthermore, you may cast any ranged Spell or Cantrip as a melee Spell. This may be toggled at any time.
Cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShockingGrasp">Shocking Grasp</LSTag> on a target moving into melee range as a free reaction.
Affected creature may cast any ranged Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> as a melee Spell.

Your melee or ranged weapons become magical, utilizing your Spellcasting Ability for Attack Rolls and damage.

Once per turn, upon killing another creature or landing a Critical Hit with your Bound Weapon, you restore a level one Spell Slot.

Your melee weapons become magical, utilizing your Spellcasting Ability for Attack Rolls and damage.

Once per turn, upon killing another creature or landing a Critical Hit with your Bound Weapon, you restore a level one Spell Slot.

Throwing a damaging grenade will trigger an additional explosion for each creature that you damage, dealing additional damage to all creatures nearby your original target. Furthermore, upon applying a coating to your weapon, it will persist until your next <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>.
You automatically succeed all <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Once per turn, gain between one and six Arcane Echoes. Arcane Echoes may be used to recover your Spell Slots.

Arcane Echoes cannot be used to recover Warlock Spell Slots.
Utilized to recover <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slots</LSTag> through <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ArcaneEchoes">Arcane Echoes</LSTag>.
Use the echoes of lingering magic within the air to replenish your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slots</LSTag>.
Spend 1 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneEchoesPoint">Arcane Echo</LSTag> in order to restore a level one <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.

Gain Blessing of Moonfire, Lunar Flare, and Lunar Strike.

In addition, dealing damage to an enemy restores 1d4 Hit Points to all nearby allies. If dealing damage in an area of effect around yourself, the heal triggers from your position, rather than your targets.
Upon <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Help">Helping</LSTag> another creature, they regain additional <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> equal to the amount you currently have.

Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistance">Resistance</LSTag> to both Lightning and Thunder damage. Upon starting your turn, and the first time that you both deal and take damage each turn, you receive one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_CHARGED_LIGHTNING">Lightning Charges</LSTag>. In addition, you gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GalvanizedStrike">Galvanized Storm Strike</LSTag>.

Strike an enemy. Afterward, until the start of their next turn, damaging them will cause a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_GalvanizedStormsoul">Galvanized Bolt</LSTag> to strike another enemy within [1] of them.

Affected creature will create a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_GalvanizedStormsoul">Galvanized Bolt</LSTag> upon being damaged by the creature who applied this condition, striking another creature within [1] of them and dealing damage equal to your level.
Strike a non <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GALVANIZED">Galvanized</LSTag> enemy with a bolt of crackling lightning, dealing damage equal to your level.
Select an archetype, a character trait, and four additional <LSTag Tooltip="SkillCheck">Skills</LSTag> to become <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Proficient</LSTag> in.

When dealing damage to an enemy, you deal an additional 1d4 Psychic damage and inflict one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_PSYCHIC_MENTAL_FATIGUE">Mental Fatigue</LSTag>. In addition, Illithid Powers no longer reduce your maximum <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>.

Once per turn, upon landing a Critical Hit, you may expend your Reaction in order to make a basic weapon-based Attack Roll.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.
Affected creature may use their <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> in order to make a basic weapon-based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
Make another attack using your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag>.
Fire another attack using your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag>.

When dealing damage to an enemy, you recover Hit Points equal to the damage you dealt divided by four. No effect on reflected damage.

This passive effect also applies to any creatures that you summon.
Upon receiving physical damage, your aggressor also takes the damage you received as Force damage.
